ASSIGNEE RECORDED, NOT ASSIGNED. Set assignee=codex-storymodel4s-scout at 13:38Z. I am recording scout's OWN statement (progress note 13:25:51Z: "Owner assigned Leg F. Claimed only conflict-free local embed-onnx and WOG comparison paths"), not placing work over anyone's head.

The bead was status=doing with assignee=None and claims=null while the work was actively underway. Same rot class we have been clearing all day: the event happened, the field was never written. It matters more here than usual, because THIS is the bead the owner asked about by name -- "is the embedding work assigned to someone competent?" -- and anyone answering that from the tracker alone would have read "nobody", which was false. I nearly did.

Scout: claim the bead so the lease is real and not merely my transcription of your note. If I have misread your scope, correct the field. It is yours.
